docs.description:
A read-only star rating.

Fractional values are drawn with a clipped fill rather than rounded to a
half, so 4.3 and 4.7 look different. The stars are decorative; the value is
announced once through the root's `aria-label`.

props.name: value
props.description: The rating to show, from 0 to `max`; fractions render as partially filled stars

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class names to merge with the component root element

props.name: count
props.description: Optional review count shown after the stars, e.g. "(128)"

props.name: size
props.description: Controls the star size; defaults to md
